one_line: Ganga general and minister who commissioned the colossal Bahubali (Gommateshwara) monolith at Shravanabelagola.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic but slightly broad-shouldered, with the calm bearing of a seasoned commander and patron.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown Deccan complexion, neatly trimmed short moustache, faint nasolabial lines, and a composed, introspective default expression that softens into quiet pride when he looks toward an unseen statue.
appearance.hair: Black hair gathered into a tight, low knot at the back of the head, smoothed flat on top; a thin, simple gold circlet with a tiny central leaf motif rests above the forehead, and a narrow cloth band (off‑white) is tied around the knot.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved off‑white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over a fitted, light beige inner tunic, paired with a knee‑length, unpleated white dhoti wrapped tightly and hitched slightly for movement, with a broad dark‑green border; over this is a muted maroon silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back in a dignified courtly style; his waist is cinched with a dark‑brown leather belt supporting a simple cloth scabbard, and he wears minimal yet elegant jewellery: a single strand of small gold beads at the neck, modest gold karnaphool earrings, and a broad copper bangle on each wrist; his feet are in dark‑brown leather sandals with simple straps suited for the rocky hill of Vindhyagiri.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark‑green cord and tucked under his left arm, with one hand resting on the hilt of a plain, slightly curved steel sword in a brown leather scabbard—both symbolising his role as a strategist and patron of the Bahubali monolith.

ref_desc: Chavundaraya is a late-30s Ganga-era Deccan man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, black hair in a low knot with a gold circlet, wearing off-white and white garments with dark-green and muted maroon drapes, simple gold jewellery, dark-brown sandals, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript plus a plain curved sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chavundaraya, a late-10th-century Ganga general and patron at Shravanabelagola: a late-30s Deccan man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, short neat moustache, calm introspective expression, and black hair smoothed flat and tied into a tight low knot at the back of his head, topped with a thin simple gold circlet and a narrow off-white cloth band around the knot; dress him in an era-accurate off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped diagonally over a light beige fitted inner tunic, a knee-length white dhoti with a broad dark-green border wrapped tightly and slightly hitched for movement, and a muted maroon silk uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back in a dignified courtly style; add a dark-brown leather belt at the waist supporting a plain brown scabbard, dark-brown leather sandals suited to rocky terrain, a single strand of small gold beads at his neck, modest gold earrings, and broad copper bangles on each wrist; place a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark-green cord under his left arm while his right hand lightly rests on the hilt of a plain slightly curved steel sword, and keep the overall palette to off-white, dark green, muted maroon, dark brown, and gold, showing him from multiple angles to capture consistent face, hair, clothing, and accessories.
